heading: 2.1 1. Macroeconomic Factors
text: GDP Growth: Probability economic expansion contraction affecting investment opportunities.Interest Rates: Probability fluctuations impacting borrowing costs investment decisions.Inflation: Probability moderate inflation benefiting asset values high inflation increasing costs.Unemployment Rate: Probability lower unemployment increasing consumer spending higher unemployment reducing demand.Government Policies: Probability supportive restrictive policies impacting investment sectors.Currency Movements: Probability depreciation increasing import costs appreciation reducing expenses.Commodity Prices: Probability price increases raising costs decreases lowering expenses.

heading: 2.2 2. Sector-Specific Factors
text: Sector Growth Rate: Probability sector expansion due market trends contraction adverse conditions.Technological Advancements: Probability innovation driving growth obsolescence impacting competitiveness.Regulations: Probability favorable policies supporting growth restrictive regulations increasing compliance costs.Supply Chain Issues: Probability disruptions delaying projects improvements reducing costs.Demand Trends: Probability rising demand boosting investments declining demand reducing opportunities.Sector Sentiment: Probability positive investor sentiment driving growth negative sentiment limiting investments.

heading: 2.3 3. Market Factors
text: Market Liquidity: Probability high liquidity enabling smooth transactions low liquidity increasing volatility.Investor Sentiment: Probability optimism boosting investment inflows pessimism leading sell-offs.Institutional Buying/Selling: Probability large-scale institutional investments withdrawals influencing market trends.Volatility: Probability stable market conditions high volatility affecting investment stability.

heading: 2.4 4. Standard Investment Factors
text: Value (P/E): Probability undervaluation presenting buying opportunity overvaluation limiting returns.Quality (ROE): Probability strong returns equity driving investment attractiveness weak returns impacting valuation.Momentum (Price Trend): Probability upward momentum indicating growth potential downward trends signaling caution.ROCE (Return Capital Employed): Probability efficient capital use generating high returns inefficiencies lowering profitability.Size (Market Capitalization): Probability company sector gaining large-cap status remaining small/mid-cap range.Volatility (Beta): Probability low beta indicating stability high beta signaling sensitivity market conditions.Alpha (Risk-Adjusted Return): Probability strong risk-adjusted performance underperformance relative benchmarks.Beta (Systematic Risk): Probability low systematic risk stable investments high beta indicating exposure market fluctuations.

heading: 2.5 5. Growth Investing Factors
text: Growth Rate: Probability sustained revenue earnings growth time.Quality Growth: Probability growth driven strong fundamentals versus temporary market conditions.Longevity Growth: Probability company’s sector’s growth sustainable long run.Scalability: Probability business model able scale efficiently without significant cost increases.Market Expansion: Probability entering new markets expanding market share contributing sustained growth.Innovation & R&D: Probability continuous innovation driving competitive advantage future revenue streams.Competitive Positioning: Probability maintaining strengthening market leadership competitors.Profitability Growth: Probability revenue growth translating actual profitability rather just higher costs.

heading: 2.6 6. Balance Sheet Factors
text: Debt Levels: Probability manageable debt improving financial stability versus excessive debt increasing financial risk.Liquidity Ratios: Probability strong liquidity ensuring smooth operations versus liquidity constraints limiting flexibility.Asset Quality: Probability high-quality assets appreciating value versus low-quality assets leading impairments.Cash Flow Stability: Probability consistent positive cash flow supporting growth versus erratic cash flow affecting financial planning.Capital Structure: Probability optimal mix debt equity enhancing financial resilience versus unbalanced structure increasing risk.Working Capital Efficiency: Probability efficient working capital management improving operations versus inefficiencies leading cash flow problems.Dividend Sustainability: Probability consistent growing dividends indicating financial strength versus unsustainable payouts leading cuts.Book Value Growth: Probability rising book value per share reflecting increasing intrinsic worth versus declining book value signaling potential issues.

heading: 2.7 7. Operating Leverage Factors
text:
Fixed vs. Variable Costs: Probability high fixed-cost structure amplifying profit growth versus variable costs providing flexibility.Break-even Point: Probability reaching break-even point faster high operating leverage versus slower low leverage.Margin Expansion: Probability improving operating margins revenue grows due fixed cost absorption.Cost Efficiency: Probability leveraging economies scale reduce per-unit costs improve profitability.Revenue Sensitivity: Probability revenue fluctuations significantly impacting profitability due high operating leverage.Operational Flexibility: Probability adapting cost structures changing market conditions efficiently.
